main_body: Vertical steel column with a flared octagonal/rounded capital at the top (rows 8-16), a fluted shaft with three horizontal rings (rows 17-40), and a flared base (rows 41-47).
top_band: Light-mid steel grey (#a2aebc) horizontal top surface across rows 9-11 (with a 2px lighter highlight on row 9 cols 3-4), bounded at the front by a 1-row bright steel highlight line (#c9d4e0) on row 12.
evidence: Reading column 7 from the top: row 8 is the top outline; rows 9-11 form a 3-row horizontal top plane (#a2aebc); row 12 is a distinct 1-row lighter front-edge highlight (#c9d4e0) making a 4-row top band; row 13 is the vertical rim with rivet holes; rows 14-16 form a dark overhanging shadow band (#313944/#262c35) above the narrower fluted shaft (rows 17-40) and matching 3/4 beveled base (rows 41-47).

style.evidence: Although the steel ramp uses 6 distinct grey values with specular highlights and rivets, the entire silhouette (including the top cap and lit left edge) is enclosed in a uniform 1px near-black outline (#0e1116) and the three shaft segments (rows 17-24, 25-31, 32-38) are mechanically identical repeats with no surface grain, giving it a sticker-like appearance next to the Beodeul references.
